mapper.sql: SELECT pt.code, pt.name, pt.chip_bg, pt.chip_fg, pt.homepage_url, pt.exposed, pt.sort_order, (SELECT count(*) FROM collect_url c WHERE c.partner_code = pt.code AND c.url_type = 'POSTPAID') AS postpaid_urls, (SELECT count(*) FROM collect_url c WHERE c.partner_code = pt.code AND c.url_type = 'PREPAID') AS prepaid_urls, (SELECT count(*) FROM collect_url c WHERE c.partner_code = pt.code AND c.url_type = 'MONTHLY') AS monthly_urls, (SELECT count(*) FROM partner_tab t WHERE t.partner_code = pt.code AND t.status = 'NEW') AS new_tabs, s.enabled AS schedule_enabled, s.days AS schedule_days, s.run_time AS schedule_time, r.finished_at AS last_run_at, r.result AS last_run_result, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crawl_job j WHERE j.partner_code = pt.code AND j.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND j.due_at <= now() + interval '1 hour') AS job_waiting FROM partner pt LEFT JOIN crawl_schedule s ON s.partner_code = pt.code LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( -- 가장 최근 작업의 유형별 실행을 합쳐 한 줄로 (하나라도 실패면 실패) SELECT max(finished_at) AS finished_at, CASE WHEN bool_or(result = 'FAILED') THEN 'FAILED' WHEN bool_or(result = 'ABNORMAL') THEN 'ABNORMAL' ELSE 'SUCCESS' END AS result FROM crawl_run WHERE job_id = (SELECT max(job_id) FROM crawl_run WHERE partner_code = pt.code) HAVING count(*) > 0 ) r ON TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO partner (code, name, chip_bg, chip_fg, homepage_url, exposed, sort_order) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{chipBg}, #{chipFg}, #{homepageUrl}, #{exposed}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, partner_code, url_type, url, label, sort_order FROM collect_url WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collect_url (partner_code, url_type, url, label, sort_order) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{urlType}, #{url}, #{label}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM collect_url WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND url_type = #{urlType}
SELECT id, partner_code, url, label, status FROM partner_tab WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE partner_tab SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM partner_tab WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND url = #{url}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_schedule (partner_code, enabled, days, run_time) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, #{enabled}, #{days}, #{runTime}) ON CONFLICT (partner_code) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, days = EXCLUDED.days, run_time = EXCLUDED.run_time, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crawl_job WHERE partner_code = #{partnerCode} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND due_at <= now() + interval '1 hour')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawl_job (partner_code, trigger, run_on, requested_by) VALUES (#{partnerCode}, 'MANUAL', #{runOn}, #{requestedBy})
